title: DSH integration dependency bump
summary: A dependency-only change inside the `integrations/dsh` workspace package: the dev dependency on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` moves from 0.1.5-rc.2 to 0.1.5-rc.3, and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` moves back from 3.18.4 to 3.18.2. The lockfile is regenerated to match, which also tightens the `@deepseek-ai/cordis` peer range declared by dsh-llm from `^4.0.2` to the exact `4.0.2`. No source code changes; the blast radius is the DSH integration's build and test toolchain and the shared lockfile every workspace package resolves through.

nodes.label: @deepseek-ai/cordis
nodes.summary: The plugin runtime every DeepSeek package peers on. Its version does not move, but the peer range dsh-llm declares against it narrows, which is why it appears in the lockfile diff.

edges.label: peer: 4.0.2 (exact)
edges.summary: The new dsh-llm release candidate narrows its cordis peer range from a caret range to an exact version. The installed cordis stays at 4.0.4, so this is a declaration change rather than a resolution change.
